_meta.status_legend: EVAL = simulator/model par measured · RULE = designed rule (Layer B), simulated nahi · UX = interface safeguard · PARTNER = external hook chahiye (PSP/bank/telecom/registry)
_meta.note: Ye rules deck ke R1–R14 ke saath chalti hain, unki jagah nahi leti. Sab rules sirf 'friction badhate' hain — auto-block koi rule nahi karta.

rules.feature: F1 · Chat-Before-Pay Guard (contact tier × chat-session length)
rules.name: app-switch + contact-tier + session-duration gate
rules.trigger: WhatsApp/Telegram foreground → UPI app foreground (≤ 5 min gap) AND payment screen open (upi:// intent ya in-app pay flow)
inputs: UsageStatsManager events (app-switch + chat session ki lambai)
journey memory (new payee? amount vs norm?)
rules.action:
4-cell matrix lagti hai — contact (saved/unknown) × chat session (chhoti <8 min / lambi ≥8 min):
  · SAVED + chhoti chat  → T1 fast path: 1.0 min check, phir seedha payment; ya ek tap me saved number par call-confirm karke payment allow.
  · SAVED + lambi chat (≥10 min) → T1 notification (3 min): lambi baat ke turant baad payment = coercion/pressure ka pattern; number saved hone par bhi account-hack possible.
  · UNKNOWN + chhoti chat → T2 cooling 8 min guided check (user ko samjhaane me time lagta hai) + 3 sawal.
  · UNKNOWN + lambi chat → T3 hold + analyst callback (digital-arrest / task-script pattern).
  · chat hi nahi → T1 nudge only (0 min), koi hold nahi.
Timer sirf foreground dwell count karta hai (chat screen par). Payment rukta hai, block nahi hota — user kabhi bhi cancel kar sakta hai.
rules.escalation: jawab risky (offer/officer/call) → T3 hold + analyst callback; 24h sticky watch naye payee par
rules.ui_copy_hi: Fast path: “Saved contact — 1 minute check, phir pay.” · Notification: “Aapke saath 10+ minute chat ke baad payment app khula hai. Ruko — kya koi aapko paisa bhejne ko keh raha hai?” · Cooling: “Unknown contact — 8 minute me chat dobara padho aur 3 sawal.” · Hold: “Unknown number + lambi chat + turant payment. Koi officer/bank UPI par paisa nahi mangta.”
rules.ui_copy_en: You just came from a chat into this payment. Re-read that chat (unknown contact: 9 min). Nothing is blocked — you keep the final call.
rules.anti_cheat: timer foreground-dwell only · app leave = pause · 5s me wapas UPI = no credit · notification/cooldown 'It's me' se nahi khulta (sawal ya trusted person chahiye) · fast path bhi per-payee 24h me ek baar
rules.status: EVAL (matrix demo me tested) + RULE + UX
rules.honest_limit: M1 'padha' nahi naap sakta — sirf 'kitni der chat screen par the'. Isliye fast path par bhi Q1 + call-confirm option, aur lambi-chat case me sirf notification (block nahi).

saved_long.note: agar call/chat me 'paisa bhejo' bola ja raha hai → T3

rules.name: chat-before-pay memory
rules.trigger: payment ke 24h/7d andar kitni baar chat→pay pattern hua, aur kaunse contacts se
rules.action: model feature: chat_then_pay_count_24h, unknown_chat_pay_ratio, same_payee_after_chat. Score ke saath reason generator me jaata hai.
rules.honest_limit: 25% devices par UsageStats access nahi hota → feature NaN, model fallback (deck A4 principle).

rules.name: screenshot → scene provenance + payment-screenshot burst
rules.trigger: (a) naya screenshot MediaStore me aaya, ya (b) ek hi screenshot repeated/duplicate (perceptual hash)
inputs: UsageStats event @ same timestamp (kaunsa app foreground)
browser → URL (supervised phone ke liye Accessibility/Notification route; warna text field se OCR — opt-in)
UPI app → OCR (opt-in) se UPI ID / amount / merchant
rules.action: har screenshot ko tag: source app + extracted entities + trust level. 30 min me ≥3 payment-screenshots ⇒ amber; ≥5 ya unverified source ⇒ red warning + agle payment par cooling.
rules.ui_copy_hi: Aapne thodi der me kaafi payment screenshots liye hain. Jo bhi pay karne ko keh raha hai, usse ruk kar ek baar apni app me khud confirm karo — kisi screenshot par bharosa mat karo.
rules.privacy: burst detection OCR ke BINA chalta hai (UsageStats ∩ MediaStore). OCR opt-in, on-device; image store nahi hoti — sirf extracted entity (domain/UPI ID/amount) + hash, 7 din.
rules.honest_limit: Web se aaya screenshot ka source-domain 100% reliable nahi (Chrome tab title URL = permission). Isliye ise 'evidence', verdict nahi, treat karte hain.

rules.name: 4-level domain trust ladder (+ gateway-merchant mismatch)
rules.trigger: koi bhi link / domain / screenshot me dikha domain / QR ke peeche ka URL / SMS-Chrome text
inputs: L1 registry: RBI/NPCI/bank/PSP domains (app OTA JSON)
heuristics: homoglyph, typosquat Levenshtein ≤2, brand-in-subdomain, punycode xn--, risky TLD, URL shortener, no-HTTPS, IP-literal, '@' trick
production: RDAP domain age (< 90d), DoT FRI, I4C suspect registry
rules.action: L1/L2 = pass · L3 unverified-clean = amber warning + naam/QR check · L4 lookalike/fake = red warning + cooling, aur 1930 pack shortcut
rules.ui_copy_hi: Ye website hamari verified list me nahi hai. Sirf tab pay karo jab aapne khud ye site kholi ho.
rules.note: Gateway legit hone par bhi merchant unverified ho to warning (classic 2026 trick). Wording: 'scam' nahi, 'verified nahi hai' — deck ke non-accusing principle ke hisaab se.

rules.name: user-facing scam explainer with deterministic verdicts
rules.trigger: user khud chat/email/SMS/link/screenshot-text paste karke poochhta hai
inputs: threat library F1–F18 / T1–T24 + Intel Desk ke naye patterns
rules.action: verdict (SEEMS OK / CAUTION / SCAM LIKELY / PAKKA NAHI BATA SAKTA) + 3 reasons + turant kya karo + kya mat karo + library citation. LLM sirf explanation likhta hai, verdict nahi deta. Low-confidence → human analyst queue + 1930 pack.
rules.tier: T1 (advisory) → T3 (agar user live payment me ho)
rules.status: RULE + UX · LLM production me optional (env-var switch), prompt-injection guard, PII on-device
rules.honest_limit: Naya pattern jo library me nahi hai → low confidence par honest 'pakka nahi' jawab, fake confidence nahi.

rules.name: linked-app + mandate + delegate audit
inputs: SMS DLT mandate format ('will be auto-debited')
rules.action: warnings: Daily/Weekly mandate jiska purpose 'one-time' bataya gaya · naya mandate (≤7d) + unverified merchant · naya delegate · ek bank account 4+ apps me · idle wallet linked. One-tap revoke.
rules.ui_copy_hi: quickearn-pro@ybl se ₹299 roz kata ja raha hai — kal se shuru, aur ye merchant verified nahi hai. Ek tap me band karo.
rules.status: RULE + UX · authoritative list = PARTNER · shared mule/mandate clusters = PARTNER (hashed, k≥5)

rules.name: internet-wide new-scam discovery → review → library push
rules.trigger: roz (cron) ya ops console se manual run
rules.action: fetch → fraud filter (EN+HI) → dedupe (URL + fuzzy title) → family classify (F1–F18) → novelty check → REVIEW queue → analyst 15-sec verdict → threat library + registry + detector update (app OTA)
rules.status: EVAL (chali hui: 784 raw → 172 relevant → 63 novel-review, 02 Oct 2026)
rules.honest_limit: Headline-level crawl hai (article body nahi — DPDP + copyright safe). ~37% items generic bucket me rukte hain. Auto-publish nahi — human approve karta hai.

rules.name: same-user / same-payee multiple payment guard
rules.trigger: 24h me usi payee ko 3+ payment, ya 7d me 3+ naye payee + badhta amount (staircase)
rules.action: 3rd payment se pehle cooling + 'staircase' reason; 4th+ par hold (≥2 evidence groups) + analyst callback; trusted-person approval
rules.ui_copy_hi: Aapne 24 ghante me isi account ko 3 baar paisa bheja hai. Task/investment scam me aisa hi hota hai — chhota se shuru, phir badhta jaata hai.

rules.name: chat-session duration + session→payment gap feature
rules.trigger: har app-switch event par: chat session kitni lambi thi, gap kitna chhota tha, aur session ke andar kitne message/notification events aaye (count only)
rules.action: model features: chat_session_sec, session_to_pay_gap_sec, long_chat_flag, chat_pay_ratio_7d. Notification/low-friction tier ka trigger bhi yahi deta hai.
rules.honest_limit: Content nahi padhte — isliye 'lambi chat' ka matlab 'zyada der baat hui', 'manipulation hui' nahi. Pressure ka proof 3 sawal / analyst call se aata hai.

rules.name: one-tap fraud report pack
rules.trigger: user 'fraud hua' bole/confirm kare, ya journey model T3 hold ke baad scam confirm ho, ya user khud Report dabaye
rules.action: 4 minute ka pack generate: NCRP form text (HI+EN) copy-ready · ready email cyber-cell/bank ke liye (crops attached) · 1930 call-sheet (txn/UTR top par) · annexure index (SHA-256) · ZIP bundle. User ko sirf bhejna/review karna hai.
rules.status: EVAL (asli case par chala: 28 screenshots → pack)
rules.honest_limit: Email auto-bhejne se pehle user ko ek baar dikhana zaroori hai (galat details jaane ka risk). Receiver ki email IDs official list se hi (harvested nahi).

rules.name: crop · redact · hash (chain of custody)
rules.action: smart crop (status bar/nav/letterbox hata) · QR detect+decode (UPI ID nikaalna) · 2 copies: full (officials) + redacted (share) · per-file SHA-256 + manifest. Originals kabhi modify nahi.
rules.honest_limit: Redaction pattern-based hai — CJK/OCR-miss cases me user ko manual check karna chahiye (UI me 'verify' step).
